name: hhauer-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for design mapping, as-built documentation, codebase review, and Forgejo/Gitea repository work.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Tends a project's OKF knowledge bundles: the widen and deepen skills map design intent under design/ (researching open questions with the waypoint-researcher and waypoint-prototyper agents, and auditing the record for internal consistency with the wayfinding-auditor agent at session close), and the document skill generates and maintains as-built documentation under docs/ from the code itself (via the enumerator, scribe, synthesizer, and verifier agents). Ships the lint_bundle.py linter both sides run before committing.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Code and documentation review: the codebase sweep and survey skills plus the readiness, structure-miner, refactor-audit, arcc-review, and design-adversary agents. Bundles the just recipe library refactor-audit runs on.

plugins.name: forgejo
plugins.description: The fj skill: a command surface for Forgejo and Gitea repositories — issues, labels, pull requests, releases, and CI status — for any host, via the fj CLI.
